newsitem.title: POLAND: Amerbank plans 1.2 mln share issue.
newsitem.headline: Amerbank plans 1.2 mln share issue.

text.p: Amerbank SA will on November 15 ask shareholders to approve a new issue of up to 1.2 million shares offered ex-rights, the bank said in a statement.
Amerbank said the executive board would decide whether or not to offer the shares to a chosen foreign bank, an international financial institution, or both.

The bank said that, if selected institutions failed to subscribe at least 500,000 shares, the issue would be offered to the public. The price of the new shares will be determined by the bank's management. The bank currently has 2.7 million shares outstanding.
